killedBy: hud.css is syntactically whole never centres the main axis of a pane that scrolls
why: Restores the shape Settings shipped before issue #642: `justify-content: center` on an `overflow-y: auto` column puts the overflow ABOVE the scrollable area, where no scrollbar reaches it. Measured through tools/screens at 844x390 -- a handset in landscape, an ordinary viewport rather than a contrived one -- where the pane's own "Settings" heading sat at y = -64, its whole box above the scroll origin and unreachable by any scroll. jsdom lays nothing out, so the case that kills this reads the computed `justify-content` of every scroller the fixture builds and asserts that set is EMPTY; the scroller names are pinned in the same assertion so an empty result cannot come from measuring nothing.
